mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, which signals strong economic growth and corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters a growth phase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth phase (INDPRO > 1.5% YoY), the economy is expanding, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rise above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and a decline in unemployment rate indicate a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS grows and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong GDP growth phase (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), the economy is expanding, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
